{"id":1885885692,"question_id":525,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768487310,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"28 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1885885692/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Contiguous Array","memory":"94.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int findMaxLength(vector<int>& nums) {\n        vector<int>modified(nums.size() , 1);\n        for(int i = 0 ;i < nums.size() ; i++) if(nums[i] == 0) modified[i] = -1;\n\n        vector<int>cumsum(nums.size()+1 , 0);\n        cumsum[0] = modified[0];\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<modified.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            cumsum[i] = cumsum[i-1] + modified[i];\n        }\n\n        int maxlen = 0;\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n        int sum = 0;\n        mp[0] = -1;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            sum = cumsum[i];\n\n            if(mp.count(sum)) maxlen = max(maxlen , i - mp[sum]);\n            else mp[sum] = i;\n        }\n    return maxlen;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"contiguous-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1493}
